question: Who discovered three chemical elements: cerium, thorium and selenium, and devised the modern method by which one or two letters are used to symbolise elements?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jacob Berzelius**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jacob Berzelius** discovered three chemical elements: cerium, thorium and selenium, and devised the modern method by which one or two letters are used to symbolise elements.
 
• **In 1813, J.J. Berzelius** proposed that chemical symbols should be based on the Latin names of the elements.
 
• He is among the founders of modern Chemistry and is known for his work on atomic weight which led to several developments in chemistry.
 
• Chemical symbols are the abbreviations used for chemical elements.
 
• It usually consists of one or two letters from the Latin alphabet.
 
• For example, the chemical symbol of** lead is Pb which is derived from plumbum in Latin. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **John Dalton**

 
 
• He was an English physicist and chemist.
 
• He is known for **introducing atomic theory into chemistry**.
 
• He is a pioneer in research into colour blindness and his theory is also known as Daltonism after his name.
 
 
 
• **Phosphorus **is a chemical element with an atomic number 15.
 
 
• It was discovered by** Hennig Brand in 1669.**
 
• Phosphorus has the smell of garlic.
 
• Phosphorus is never found as a free element on earth due to its high reactivity.
 
 
 
• **In 1915**, The Bohr model of the atom was proposed by** Neil Bohr.**
 
 
• **Bohr's model** explains that electrons move in fixed orbitals.
 
• Bohr also explained that each orbit has a fixed energy level Bohr's model.
 
• Electrons revolve around the nucleus in a definite circular path called orbits in an atom.
 
• Each orbit has fixed energy and these orbits are called orbital shells.
 
• The electrons move from a lower to a higher energy level by gaining the required energy and an electron moves from a higher to a lower energy level by losing energy in an atom.
